method: Local APK bytecode inspection and in-memory comparison against existing user-generated captures; no network requests sent

login.algorithm: Lowercase MD5 hex digest of the UTF-8 plaintext password, 32 hexadecimal characters
login.password_normalization: No case conversion or whitespace trimming before hashing
login.legacy_model_note: Unused UserLoginPwdRequest has different fields password and clientId; do not use that model for the observed login flow

trade_authorization_research_only.algorithm: SM2 public-key encryption with SM3 and randomized ephemeral scalar on the standard SM2 curve
trade_authorization_research_only.ciphertext_format: Lowercase hexadecimal C1 || C3 || C2, with the uncompressed point's initial 04 byte removed
trade_authorization_research_only.public_key_source: Hardcoded 65-byte uncompressed public EC point in Sm2Util.publicKeyHexToBytes; not derived from the account or token
trade_authorization_research_only.randomness_source: BouncyCastle ECKeyPairGenerator initialized with Java SecureRandom
